column30: Crypto-Arsenal is a platform for anyone to invest in cryptos through trading bots. We empower developers to easily create trading strategies; and for traders who can not code are able to adopt strategies for live-trading. Traders only pay developers when they profit.
column31: With our proprietary 'Containerized StrategyBot Engine', everyone can backtest and paper-trade strategies with real-time market data to validate their performances. Bots are containerized for optimal security, reliability and performance. Quantitative hedge funds have access to these tools, but general traders don't.  'Strategy Arena' is created for developers to publish their strategies. We rank strategies by performance to not only incentivize developers but also help traders decide and adopt. 'Watchlist' allows traders to add in strategies filtered from 'Strategy Arena' for further validations. A single watchlist acts exactly as a strategy portfolio, consisting of a number of strategies of a specific market. Traders can create more than one watchlist.  As opposed to a 'Marketplace' model, we run on a 'Split-As-You-Profit' model which guarantees traders no upfront charges until adopted strategies have profited.  In short, our platform creates values for developers to shorten the development cycle and monetize their strategies; for traders, we minimize efforts to adopt trading bots and maximize profit with strategy portfolios.
